title: Upload a single reference image of your character, then describe the world in…
content: Upload a single reference image of your character, then describe the world in the prompt and let Seedance 2.5 on Morphic generate the story/video from that setup.
tips: Upload a single reference image of your character, then describe the world in the prompt and let Seedance 2.5 on Morphic generate the story/video from that setup.

es.content: Sube una sola imagen de referencia de tu personaje, luego describe el mundo en el prompt y deja que Seedance 2.5 en Morphic genere la historia o el video a partir de esa configuración.

fr.content: Téléchargez une seule image de référence de votre personnage, puis décrivez le monde dans le prompt et laissez Seedance 2.5 sur Morphic générer l’histoire/la vidéo à partir de cette configuration.

ja.content: キャラクターの参照画像を1枚アップロードし、promptで世界観を説明してください。あとは、その設定をもとにMorphic上のSeedance 2.5がストーリー／動画を生成します。

ko.content: 캐릭터의 단일 레퍼런스 이미지를 업로드한 다음, prompt에서 세계관을 설명하면 Morphic의 Seedance 2.5가 그 설정을 바탕으로 스토리/비디오를 생성합니다.

pt.content: Envie uma única imagem de referência do seu personagem, depois descreva o mundo no prompt e deixe o Seedance 2.5 no Morphic gerar a história/vídeo a partir dessa configuração.

zh.content: 上传一张你角色的单张参考图，然后在 prompt 中描述世界观，让 Morphic 上的 Seedance 2.5 根据这个设定生成故事/视频。
